mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned 495 km2 project, Toodoggone District, north-central BC. Jan 2026 pre-feasibility study: 15-year open-pit heap-leach mine life; measured + indicated resources 4.56 Moz AuEq @ 1.21 g/t (including 97.89 Moz Ag @ 25.9 g/t); average annual production ~187,000 AuEq oz/yr including 3.5 Moz Ag; after-tax NPV5% US$2.37B (C$3.37B), IRR 54.4%. Pre-production development-stage; no production or reserves. Advanced permitting.

notes: Formerly Thesis Gold Inc.; renamed Thesis Gold & Silver Inc. Feb 2026. TSX-V:TAU, OTCQX:THSGF. Developer; no FY2025 production, revenue, or reserves. Flagship Lawyers-Ranch PFS (Jan 2026) as above. All amounts per company disclosures (USD/CAD as noted).
